run_openbookqa_preprocessing: run the OpenbookQA dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_openbookqa_dataset_instance: create an OpenbookQA dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace openbookqa main split
extract_choices_and_answer: extract the multiple choice options and correct answer string from an OpenbookQA datapoint
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace OpenbookQA dataset split to a list of question and answer tuples
load_openbookqa_hf_dataset: load the OpenbookQA dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
